prompt: Bug report: oneapi::dal::finiteness_checker gives a wrong answer for double-precision data. With `set_allow_NaN(true)`, a table that contains +inf or -inf is reported as finite (get_finite() == true) when the table is small (e.g. a 1x1 table holding +inf). The same input in single precision (float) is correctly reported as not finite. Infinities must never be treated as finite, regardless of allow_NaN. Find and fix the root cause in the library. `bazel` is on PATH; this machine has no GPU. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
